extraction.pages_processed: 5-6 (contents), 15-16 (overview), 31-32, 43-46, 59-60, 66-68, 80-82, 96-98 (North Macedonia country note); keyword screen over all 109 pages, with lines around each match read on the other pages
extraction.notes: Regional report of 109 pages: read the contents, the overview from page 15, the North Macedonia country note and the passages on digitalisation, migration, AI and the jobs strategy, and ran a keyword screen over the whole text (digital, electronic, e-government, online, cyber, AI, interoperability, personal data, broadband, 5G, internet, foreign, migrant, immigration, work permit, third-country, social security, EURES, EHIC). Page numbers are those of the PDF and the converted text, not the printed page numbers. Under the rule for regional documents, only claims naming North Macedonia, or the region where it is named in the passage, are extracted. Item 0004 (Table 1.2, page 46, which does not name North Macedonia) was removed at the second pass under that rule; its ID stays unused and its full text is in review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/MKD-IO-2025-001.csv for the analyst at G5. LEFT OUT because the passage does not name North Macedonia, for the analyst to confirm: page 60 (foreign-born residents addressing shortages; targeted immigration policies; social security portability for emigrants) and page 80 (simplifying immigration rules; digitalising registration and reporting; digital inspection tools) and pages 81-82 (digital infrastructure, AI and telemedicine, national single windows). Also left out: pages 16 and 43 (lists of five reform areas with no claim beyond page 45), page 66 (online job postings and digital skills demand, not linked to an in-scope recommendation), pages 31-32 (financial inclusion and other digital finance content), page 74 (digitalisation as one form of firm upgrading). ICT employment figures are out of scope. The report contains no claim on foreign workers in North Macedonia specifically, and nothing on EURES, the European Labour Authority or social security coordination in the Chapter 2 sense. Pages 2, 12, 83 and 109 (text recognition) have no quoted content. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2). Items 0008 and 0009 were added by the second-pass checker. Items removed at the second pass restored at G5 (G5-D02) and marked as regional.
